standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of the pullback with colimits and its right exactness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 989-990 as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports the surjection exhibiting the global generators to the pullback.

core_obligations: Reduce to generators on one open: for an open subspace of the target the proof writes down the commutative square expressing the pullback of the restricted module as the pullback along the induced morphism, so it suffices to treat a module admitting a surjection from a direct sum of copies of the structure sheaf (proof lines 974-986)

Apply the pullback: since the pullback commutes with colimits and is right exact, applying it to the displayed surjection produces a surjection onto the pulled back module from a direct sum of copies of the structure sheaf of the source (proof lines 988-1007)
Conclude: the existence of such a surjection is precisely the statement (proof lines 1008-1009)
proof_roadmap: 先对目标的开子空间 V 写出方形图，由 f^*G|_{f^{-1}V} ≅ (f')^*(G|_V)（跨章引理）化归到 G 整体生成的情形。
由 f^* 与 colim 交换且右正合（本章引理），对满射 ⊕_{i∈I}O_Y → G → 0 作用 f^* 得 ⊕_{i∈I}O_X → f^*G → 0，即结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of a module locally generated by sections is again locally generated by sections (author lemma at source lines 965-971, label lemma-pullback-locally-generated). The proof (source lines 973-1010) reduces to a globally generated module by comparing the pullback of a restriction with the pullback along the induced morphism, and then applies the compatibility of the pullback with colimits and its right exactness to the surjection exhibiting the generators (proof lines 974-1007). The reduction to the globally generated case is the content. H2.
